scope: Mock OAuth and mock inference in isolated Chrome; no real account consent or provider requests

checks.check: Disconnected UI is read-only; consent is a native user-operated form
Connection controls fit mobile and Escape restores focus
Mock consent returns to first-use confirmation and account-specific model picker
Mock completed inference renders exact evidence without exposing tokens
Usage failure shows labelled fallback, pauses requests and offers Manage usage
Closing copilot aborts mocked upstream work and discards the answer
Disconnect revokes mock session, clears tokens and restores demo state
No uncaught browser errors in connection lifecycle
